Here are two wide-ranging conversations about UFO disclosure, hidden technology, alleged extraterrestrial involvement, the military’s supposed role beyond Earth, and the people who may already be preparing humanity for what they believe could be one of the greatest revelations in modern history. Although the claims presented here remain unverified allegations, the truth behind them may be closer than we think. 


In the first interview a new whistleblower testimony, supported by a paper trail that includes newspaper clippings dating back to the 1950s, alleges that Area 51 may have been deliberately presented as a decoy while America’s real secret space program operated beneath Green Mountain in Huntsville, Alabama. 

The facility has been described as a “junior Pentagon” and was reportedly connected to German scientists brought to the United States through Operation Paperclip, including renowned rocket scientist Wernher von Braun. 

According to these claims, the underground facility was involved in the development of advanced propulsion systems, including alleged anti-gravity technology and spacecraft capable of traveling at speeds far beyond conventional aircraft. The Apollo program, meanwhile, supposedly served as a public-facing cover for a much more secretive space effort. 

The claims go even further, suggesting that German scientists working at the facility may have had contact with alleged Nordic extraterrestrials and that the underground complex could have played a role in developing advanced spacecraft. 

The alleged Nordic Connection allegedly training international military pilots to fly secret alien-reproduction craft  

In this second revealing interview, Dr. Michael Salla sits down with whistleblower JP to discuss a mysterious gathering of international military pilots near Eglin Air Force Base and its possible connection to an underground training program involving alleged Nordic extraterrestrials and advanced spacecraft. 

JP describes allegations of international military pilots being trained to operate reverse-engineered craft, secret missions conducted alongside an alleged off-world military force, highly classified facilities, advanced submarine-like spacecraft, hidden lunar bases, and the mysterious Project Horizon. 

He also discusses what he describes as conscious extraterrestrial technology and enormous autonomous spacecraft that, according to his account, may still be traveling through our solar system. 

(Remind Gary McKinnon — the British computer hacker who claimed to have found evidence of a hidden U.S. space program "Solar Warden" while accessing U.S. government computers. He famously reported seeing references to “non-terrestrial officers” and a “fleet-to-fleet” transfer.)
